rows.corpus_definition: To pass a sickness to a person or animal.
rows.example_en: The virus can infect many people very quickly.

rows.corpus_definition: A sickness caused by germs in the body.
rows.example_en: The cut on his hand has an infection.

rows.corpus_definition: lower in quality, rank, or importance than something else
rows.example_en: This material is inferior to the one we used before.

rows.corpus_definition: The power to change how someone thinks or behaves.
rows.example_en: He had a great influence on my career.

rows.corpus_definition: to live in or make your home in a particular place
rows.example_en: Millions of people inhabit that small island nation.

rows.corpus_definition: A person who lives in a certain place.
rows.example_en: Every inhabitant of the city received a letter.

rows.corpus_definition: Damage done to your body during an accident or sport.
rows.example_en: He has a leg injury from the football match.

rows.corpus_definition: To say strongly that something must happen.
rows.example_en: They insist on paying the bill.

rows.corpus_definition: An organization that performs research or teaches subjects.
rows.example_en: She works at a research institute in London.

rows.corpus_definition: A large formal organization like a school, hospital, or bank.
rows.example_en: She works at a large financial institution.
